tagline: Securely connecting everything to accelerate digital transformation
hero_kpi_rationale: Security revenue is a key segment for Cisco, with 59% growth in 2025, reflecting the successful integration of Splunk and the strategic priority given to security and observability solutions.
company_description: Cisco Systems, Inc. designs, develops, and sells technologies that help to power, secure, and draw insights from the internet in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, Japan, and China. The company offers data center switching; network security, identity and access management, and secure access service edge; threat intelligence, detection, and response solutions; interconnects public and private wireline and mobile networks, delivering connectivity to campus, data center, and branch networks; WEBEX suite, collaboration devices, and contact center; communication platform as a service software, including perpetual licenses, subscription arrangements, and hardware solutions; network assurance, monitoring and analytics, and observability suite; issue resolution, software support, and hardware replacement; professional services, such as planning, design, implementation, and high-value consulting; service and support packages, financing, and managed network services; and regional, national, and international wireline carriers, webscale products, internet, and cable. kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Cisco's revenue increased 5% in 2025, driven by growth across all geographic regions and the full contribution from Splunk.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Cisco's gross margin improved by 0.2 percentage points in 2025, driven by productivity improvements and cost management, partially offset by Splunk-related amortization.
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement of 0.2 percentage points in 2025

kpis.name: Security Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the Security segment including Splunk
kpis.description: Security revenue experienced 59% growth in 2025, primarily driven by Splunk's contribution and increased demand for security and observability solutions.
kpis.signal: 59% growth observed in the Security segment in 2025

kpis.name: Research and Development
kpis.description: Cisco's research and development expenses increased 16% in 2025, supporting innovation in networking, security, collaboration, and observability.
kpis.signal: Research and development expenses increased 16% in 2025

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of revenue
kpis.description: Cisco's operating margin declined by 1.8 percentage points in 2025, primarily due to increased intangible asset amortization and stock-based compensation expenses related to Splunk.
kpis.signal: Operating margin decline of 1.8 percentage points in 2025

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Cisco's net income declined 1% in 2025 to $10.18 billion, despite revenue growth, due to increased acquisition-related costs and amortization.
kpis.signal: Slight net income decline of 1% in 2025

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.description: Cisco's diluted EPS remained stable at $2.55 in 2025, reflecting effective cost management despite margin pressures.

kpis.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
kpis.description: Cisco's cash and cash equivalents declined 9% in 2025 to $16.11 billion, due to equity investments and dividend payments.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Cisco's total debt declined 9% in 2025 to $28.09 billion, reflecting active capital structure management and debt repayment.
